screener_description: Zensar Technologies is a leading digital solutions and technology services company. It is a part of the Mumbai-based RPG group and is headquartered in Pune, India. It operates in two segments: Application Management Service and Infrastructure management service. It is focused on industry verticals, such as Hitech & manufacturing, consumer services, and banking, financial services, and insurance. They have offices located in India, the USA, UK, Europe, and Africa. [1] [2]
